frontend.title: Autopilot: Mag 7 Core
frontend.subtitle: Default onboarding basket anchored to the pinned Mag 7 baseline.
frontend.summary: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside.

explanation.thesis: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside. It keeps 5% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
explanation.whatThisDoes: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside. It keeps 5% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
explanation.bestForUser: Best for someone who wants Mag 7 exposure through a curated xStocks basket with a visible 5% AUSD buffer and can accept moderate risk with roughly 18% in the largest name.
explanation.howItChanges: Rebalance only when drift clears 300 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.3% annualized turnover, 12.07 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 95% turnover and 43.25 bps total costs with 5% parked in AUSD.
explanation.replayInterpretation: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.42% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.26%. Treat replay as validation, not a promise of future returns.

bundle.whatThisPortfolioDoes: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside. It keeps 5% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
bundle.howItIsBuilt: 95% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 5% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 18%, MSFTx 16.44%, AAPLx 15.75%. Starts from the pinned Mag 7 basket membership. Selects names from the starter basket only. Keeps the basket at 6 names.
bundle.howItChanges: Rebalance only when drift clears 300 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.3% annualized turnover, 12.07 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 95% turnover and 43.25 bps total costs with 5% parked in AUSD.
bundle.whatWouldTriggerNextRebalance: A rebalance only becomes actionable when drift clears 3% and the lane is still allowed to activate under current route truth. The repo does not prove an autonomous scheduler today.
bundle.howToReadReplay: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.42% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.26%. Treat replay as validation, not a promise of future returns.
bundle.bestFor: Best for someone who wants Mag 7 exposure through a curated xStocks basket with a visible 5% AUSD buffer and can accept moderate risk with roughly 18% in the largest name.
